items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And when was Eddie Craig with Kelly? About in the 20s? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, it was about the 20s.

ctx.x: Just banjo. He used to play with Gaillet. Gaillet's the one shooting. Oh, yeah. Remember Gaillet got killed? Yeah. Gaillet's the one shooting. Oh.
And when was Eddie Craig with Kelly? About in the 20s?
Oh, it was about the 20s. Right after Kelly died, lay him out on the sand between Trayvon and Robinson in the middle on that side of the bank. He had a big few of himself stand. He did?
